label: PF Backlog 493
title: DOGFOOD P2: deterministic LLM replay harness (record/replay) + CI gate

delivery.note: Phase 2: LLM replay seam (storage.LLMReplay + llm_client._http_post) + PIPELINE_LLM_REPLAY + gate; merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: The integration dogfood could not run in CI because it makes live, non-deterministic LLM calls.
brief.what_adds: A record/replay seam at the single LLM HTTP call (core/orchestrator/llm_client.py via _http_post) backed by a cassette store (LLMReplay in core/orchestrator/storage.py); env PIPELINE_LLM_REPLAY=off|record|replay; a replay miss fails closed (never a silent network call).
brief.why: Deterministic, cost-free dogfood in CI and reproducible regression debugging.

objective: Make the integration dogfood deterministic and CI-runnable by recording/replaying LLM responses at the single LLM owner.
acceptance_criteria: record/replay seam at core/orchestrator/llm_client.py (_http_post) — extend the owner, no new engine

cassette store LLMReplay in core/orchestrator/storage.py (project-scoped products/

/.llm-cassettes)
env PIPELINE_LLM_REPLAY (off|record|replay) registered in config/env-flags.json; default off
replay-miss FAILS CLOSED (never a silent network call); off = passthrough
gate scripts/dev/dogfood_replay_check.py wired into precheck (deep); tests cover record/replay/miss
NOTE: a full executor-level replay needs an operator-recorded cassette (record requires live keys); the seam is exercised deterministically by the gate/tests.
out_of_scope: fabricating a full executor cassette (requires an operator record run)
approach: Extend the existing cache owner with a cassette store; intercept the one HTTP call via a helper; default off (production unaffected); replay miss raises (fail-closed).

prior_decisions: Output is never cached; caching is input-side only (storage.py:13-17)
Extend the owner; do not add a store (AGENTS.md)
New env switches register in config/env-flags.json
open_questions: a full executor-level replay needs an operator-recorded cassette

risks: recording requires live provider keys (operator step, not CI)
summary: Adds a deterministic, network-free LLM record/replay mode so the integration dogfood can run in CI.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/api_docs.py, core/code_quality_gate.py, core/design_critic.py, core/design_tokens.py

_note: Phase 2 delivered + validated (pytest 11 passed, gate OK, compileall, wired-audit unwired 0, lint 0 NEW)
